# AgentReady Woo

> A privacy-safe WooCommerce preflight and owner-authorized Release Gate. It checks public storefront surfaces, then lets a verified owner make a version-pinned release decision from signed aggregate plugin evidence. It does not create orders, take payment details or treat an unreadable store as a failed store.

## Public entry points

- [Website and free browser scan](https://app.utilityhouse.xyz/)
- [MCP server](https://app.utilityhouse.xyz/mcp)
- [REST preflight](https://app.utilityhouse.xyz/api/v2/preflight) — POST only
- [OpenAPI document](https://github.com/tytutueh13-sudo/agentready-woo/blob/main/openapi-preflight.yaml)
- [Support](https://app.utilityhouse.xyz/support)
- [Security](https://app.utilityhouse.xyz/security)
- [Status](https://app.utilityhouse.xyz/status)

## Root MCP tools

The root MCP server exposes five tools. The first two are public and read-only.
The final three require an account-scoped bearer token and verified store
ownership.

1. `scan_woo_store_readiness` — score readable public WooCommerce surfaces; returns `UNREADABLE` with a null score when it cannot read the store.
2. `preflight_woo_store` — passive protocol preflight over selected `woo`, `robots`, `jsonld`, `mcp`, `ucp` and `acp` families.
3. `start_woo_release_verification` — start an owner-authorized, version-pinned Release Gate run.
4. `get_woo_release_verification` — read a run owned by the authenticated account.
5. `claim_woo_release_result` — deliver one completed result; a replay is never billable.

MCP transport is JSON-RPC 2.0 and supports `initialize`, `ping`, `tools/list`
and `tools/call`. Read the schemas returned by `tools/list`; do not infer
arguments from this prose.

## Evidence and safety boundary

- Public scans read only public HTTPS pages and the public WooCommerce Store API.
- Plugin evidence is aggregate-only and HMAC-signed. Customer, order, payment, email, address, URL and raw log fields are not accepted by its schema.
- A store that cannot be read produces an abstention, not a low readiness score.
- Release Gate results can be `ACCEPTED`, `REJECTED`, `PARTIAL`, `BLOCKED`, `UNMEASURED`, `INFRA_ERROR` or `CANCELED`.
- Checkout and payment remain on the merchant's own WooCommerce store.

## Payment state

The free scan and public preflight are free. Release Gate settlement is
currently disabled while organic use and billing invariants are measured.
No plan shown on the website grants Release Gate access.

Existing account products remain separate: Commerce Readiness Packet is $9
once, Pro is $49 once, and Agency is $99/year.

## Secondary connected-store surface

An account may also connect its own read-only WooCommerce REST credentials to
serve product search, offer lookup and human-approved cart handoff from a
store-bound endpoint. That connected-store catalogue surface is separate from
the root five-tool Release Gate contract.
